arxiv-2012-04456.title: Understanding How Dimension Reduction Tools Work: An Empirical Approach to Deciphering t-SNE, UMAP, TriMap, and PaCMAP for Data Visualization
arxiv-2012-04456.creator: Yingfan Wang yingfan.wang@duke.eduDuke University, USA, Haiyang Huang haiyang.huang@duke.eduDuke University, USACynthia Rudin cynthia@cs.duke.eduDuke University, USAYaron Shaposhnik yaron@simon.rochester.eduUniversity of Rochester, USA
arxiv-2012-04456.description: Abstract Dimension reduction (DR) techniques such as t-SNE, UMAP, and TriMap have demonstrated impressive visualization performance on many real-world datasets. One tension that has always faced these methods is the trade-off between preservation of global structure and preservation of local structure: these methods can either handle one or the other, but not both.

arxiv-2107-10380.title: On the squarefree values of a 4 + b 3 a^{4}+b^{3}
arxiv-2107-10380.creator: Gian Cordana Sanjaya, Xiaoheng Wang
arxiv-2107-10380.description: Abstract In this article, we prove that the density of integers a , b a,b such that a 4 + b 3 a^{4}+b^{3} is squarefree, when ordered by max ⁡ { | a | 1 / 3 , | b | 1 / 4 } {\rm max}\{|a|^{1/3},|b|^{1/4}\} , equals the conjectured product of the local densities.

arxiv-2205-01358.title: Learning Label Initialization for Time-Dependent Harmonic Extension
arxiv-2205-01358.creator: Amitoz Azad
arxiv-2205-01358.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Amitoz Azad. Node classification on graphs can be formulated as the Dirichlet problem on graphs where the signal is given at the labeled nodes, and the harmonic extension is done on the unlabeled nodes. This paper considers a time-dependent version of the Dirichlet problem on graphs and shows how to improve its solution by learning the proper initialization vector on the unlabeled nodes. Further, we show that the improved solution is at par with state-of-the-art methods used for node classification.

arxiv-2401-03989.title: MS-DETR: Efficient DETR Training with Mixed Supervision
arxiv-2401-03989.creator: Chuyang Zhao, Yifan Sun, Wenhao Wang, Qiang Chen, Errui Ding, Yi Yang, Jingdong Wang
arxiv-2401-03989.description: Abstract DETR accomplishes end-to-end object detection through iteratively generating multiple object candidates based on image features and promoting one candidate for each ground-truth object. The traditional training procedure using one-to-one supervision in the original DETR lacks direct supervision for the object detection candidates.

arxiv-2402-15732.title: The Hilbert series of the preprojective algebras
arxiv-2402-15732.creator: Hiroyuki Minamoto
arxiv-2402-15732.description: Abstract . The aim of this short note is to prove the formula of the Hilbert series of the preprojective algebras in arbitrary characteristic by making effective use of the formulas of the Hilbert series of differential graded (dg) algebras with Adams grading.

arxiv-2507-02574.creator: Stefano Bae 1,2 , Dario Bocchi 1,2 , Luca Maria Del Bono 1,2 , Luca Leuzzi 2,1,∗
arxiv-2507-02574.description: Abstract Inverse problems arise in situations where data is available, but the underlying model is not. It can therefore be necessary to infer the parameters of the latter starting from the former. Statistical mechanics offers a toolbox of techniques to address this challenge.

arxiv-2509-16832.title: L2M-Reg: Building-level Uncertainty-aware Registration of Outdoor LiDAR Point Clouds and Semantic 3D City Models Journal: ISPRS Journal
arxiv-2509-16832.creator: Ziyang Xu*, Benedikt Schwab, Yihui Yang, Thomas H. Kolbe, Christoph Holst
arxiv-2509-16832.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ziyang Xu*, Benedikt Schwab, Yihui Yang, Thomas H. Kolbe, Christoph Holst. Accurate registration between LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) point clouds and semantic 3D city models is a fundamental topic in urban digital twinning and a prerequisite for downstream tasks, such as digital construction, change detection and model refinement. However, achieving accurate LiDAR-to-Model registration at individual building level remains challenging, particularly due to the generalization uncertainty in semantic 3D city models at the Level of Detail 2 (LoD2).

pmc-10534080.title: Thermal stress-assisted formation of submicron pillars from a thin film of CoCrCuFeNi high entropy alloy: experiments and simulations
pmc-10534080.creator: Sungmin Yoon, Yasuhiro Kimura, Shaojie Gu, Yuhki Toku, Yang Ju, Yi Cui
pmc-10534080.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). In this work, for the first time, the thermal stress-assisted formation of submicron pillars (SPs) from a high entropy alloy (HEA) thin film is made possible, and novel molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are proposed to assess the underlying mechanisms. In a series of experiments, the growth of quasi-equiatomic HEA SPs from CoCrCuFeNi HEA thin films was demonstrated under different heating and cooling conditions. Atomistic simulations are performed to probe possible formation mechanisms in two ways.

pmc-10543334.title: Effects of levothyroxine replacement therapy on insulin resistance in patients with untreated primary hypothyroidism
pmc-10543334.creator: Alireza Ostadrahimi, Taher Manzari, Sahar Gohari-Lasaki, Helda Tutunchi, Majid Mobasseri, Vahideh Sadra, Farzad Najafipour
pmc-10543334.description: ObjectivesThis study investigated the effects of levothyroxine replacement therapy on insulin resistance, lipid profile, and thyroid function in patients with untreated primary hypothyroidism. 105 patients with hypothyroidism with indication for levothyroxine replacement were enrolled in the present study. Insulin, fasting blood glucose and lipid profile were assessed at the beginning of diagnosis and three months after levothyroxine replacement.

pmc-10648024.title: Effects of Factors Influencing Scar Formation on the Scar Microbiome in Patients with Burns
pmc-10648024.creator: Yeongyun Jung, Hui Song Cui, Eun Kyung Lee, So Young Joo, Cheong Hoon Seo, Yoon Soo Cho
pmc-10648024.description: Skin microbiome dysbiosis has deleterious effects, and the factors influencing burn scar formation, which affects the scar microbiome composition, are unknown. Therefore, we investigated the effects of various factors influencing scar formation on the scar microbiome composition in patients with burns.

pmc-11391730.title: Can general exercise training and pelvic floor muscle training be used as an empowering tool among women with endometriosis? Experiences among women with endometriosis participating in the intervention group of a randomized controlled trial
pmc-11391730.creator: Merete Kolberg Tennfjord, Rakel Gabrielsen, Kari Bø, Marie Ellström Engh, Marianne Molin
pmc-11391730.description: BackgroundThe potential benefit of exercise in alleviating symptoms of endometriosis is unclear. Still, exercise may be used to empower women and manage disease symptoms. The purpose of this study was to explore how regular supervised group- and individual exercise training, including pelvic floor muscle training (PFMT), is experienced among women with endometriosis after participating in a randomized controlled trial (RCT).

pmc-11430309.title: Polarized and Evanescent Guided Wave Surface-Enhanced Raman Spectroscopy of Ligand Interactions on a Plasmonic Nanoparticle Optical Chemical Bench
pmc-11430309.creator: Xining Chen, Mark P. Andrews
pmc-11430309.description: This study examined applications of polarized evanescent guided wave surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy to determine the binding and orientation of small molecules and ligand-modified nanoparticles, and the relevance of this technique to lab-on-a-chip, surface plasmon polariton and other types of field enhancement techniques relevant to Raman biosensing.

pmc-11713044.title: Unveiling Insight: Autopsy findings on Alzheimer’s Disease Clinical Trial Participants and the multifaceted existence of comorbid pathologies
pmc-11713044.creator: Elif PINAR Coskun, Justin M Barber, Erin L Abner, Frederick A Schmitt, Larry B Goldstein, Linda J J Van Eldik, Peter T Nelson, Gregory A Jicha
pmc-11713044.description: BackgroundThe presence of multiple comorbid pathologic features in late‐onset dementia has been well documented across cohort studies that incorporate autopsy evaluation. It is likely that such mixed pathology potentially confounds the results of interventional trials that are designed to target a solitary pathophysiologic mechanism in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD).

pmc-12427878.title: Ambient Artificial Intelligence Scribes: A Pilot Survey of Perspectives on the Utility and Documentation Burden in Palliative Medicine
pmc-12427878.creator: James Patterson, Maya Kovacs, Caitlin Lees, Tin-Chih Toly Chen
pmc-12427878.description: Background/Objectives: There is growing evidence to support ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes in healthcare to improve medical documentation by generating timely and comprehensive notes. Using the Plan–Do–Study–Act (PDSA) methodology, this study evaluated the utility and potential time savings of an ambient AI scribe, Scribeberry, (V2), in a palliative medicine outpatient setting, comparing it to the standard practice of dictation.

pmc-12723343.title: Surface Behavior Regulation of Intermediates on the Copper‐Based Catalysts for Enhancing Electrocatalytic CO2 Reduction to Ethylene
pmc-12723343.creator: Peng Luo, Ziyuan Yang, Yuxia Jin, Shasha Li, Yuanchuan Hao, Yun Duan, Wei Huang, Lei Liu, Kai Yan, Abuliti Abudula, Guoqing Guan
pmc-12723343.description: Electrocatalytic CO2 reduction (CO2RR) on copper‐based catalysts uniquely enables C─C coupling to produce multi‐carbon products such as ethylene and ethanol, owing to their moderate binding affinity toward key intermediates (*CO, *H). However, industrial application is hindered by structural instability, imprecise active‐site control, complex product distributions, and competing side reactions.

pmc-13294318.creator: Huber Rizzo, Natália Carrillo Gaeta, Jeferson Silva Carvalho, Felipe Gabriel Carneiro Pessoa, Jerônimo Hugo de Souza, Guilherme José da Costa e Silva, Ana Claudia Campos, Edísio Oliveira de Azevedo, Lilian Gregory, Lúcio Esmeraldo Honório de Melo

pmc-13569980.title: Patient Safety Competency Among Operating Room Nurses: Associations With Safety Attitudes, Systems Thinking and Burnout in a Multicentre Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-13569980.creator: Daoming Chen, Chenxi Li, Yubin Su, Fang Wu, Xiaoru Fang, Hongwei Chu, Shuang Bai
pmc-13569980.description: AimTo assess self‐reported patient safety competency among operating room nurses in tertiary hospitals in Jiangsu Province, China, and to examine its associations with safety attitudes, systems thinking and burnout dimensions.DesignA multicentre cross‐sectional study.MethodsOperating room nurses were recruited from six tertiary general hospitals in Jiangsu Province, eastern China.

pmc-13674132.title: PLL‐g‐HPA Hydrogel Microneedles Loaded With Rhoifolin Target Macrophages to Alleviate Fibroblast Senescence for Diabetic Wound Healing
pmc-13674132.creator: Jiewen Liao, Lin Gan, Li Lu, Lizhi Ouyang, Yuan Xiong, Fawwaz Al‐Smadi, Guandong Dai, Mohammad‐Ali Shahbazi, Bobin Mi, Mengfei Liu, Guohui Liu
pmc-13674132.description: In this study, we demonstrate that during diabetic wound healing, interleukin‐11 (IL‐11) promotes the M1 polarization of macrophages, which subsequently triggers fibroblast senescence through the enhanced release of pro‐inflammatory cytokines IL‐1β and IL‐6. Notably, Rhoifolin (Rho) effectively inhibits IL‐11‐induced M1 polarization, alleviates the secretion of IL‐1β and IL‐6, and concurrently promotes the release of choline, thereby mitigating fibroblast senescence.

pmc-13681918.title: Promoter G-quadruplex structures regulate tissue-specific gene expression and functional differentiation in Bombyx mori
pmc-13681918.creator: Lijun Xiang, Jin Li, Bingxian Wu, Tingting Yao, Xiaojuan Zhang, Keling Wu, Mingxi Zheng, Qili Feng, Kangkang Niu
pmc-13681918.description: BackgroundDNA G-quadruplex structures (G4s) are noncanonical nucleic acid structures that play crucial roles in gene transcription regulation, particularly when located within promoter regions. Tissue-specific gene expression underlies the development and functional specialization of multicellular organisms. However, the potential role of G4s in tissue-specific transcriptional regulation remains largely unexplored.

pmc-13685147.title: Intracranial lesion yield and downstream management after mild traumatic brain injury in emergency department patients receiving antiplatelet therapy: a two-center retrospective cohort study
pmc-13685147.creator: Fatima Di Padova, Tifany Sekulski, Dounia Hamdouche, Romain Jouffroy, Vincent Garrouste
pmc-13685147.description: BackgroundMild traumatic brain injury (mTBI) in patients receiving antiplatelet therapy is a frequent emergency department presentation. We aimed to describe the prevalence of traumatic intracranial lesions on the initial head computed tomography (CT) scan and the downstream in-hospital management of antiplatelet-treated adults with mTBI.

pmc-13686555.title: Urinary Incontinence and Risk of All‐Cause Mortality: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis of Observational Studies
pmc-13686555.creator: Yanyan Zhou, Liwei Wang, Weijia Sun, Zhong Wang, Kuiqing Shao, Feng Xu, Zhan Gao
pmc-13686555.description: AimsUrinary incontinence (UI) is a prevalent condition among adults and imposes a substantial societal burden, yet its association with all‐cause mortality remains uncertain. This study systematically reviewed and quantified the association between UI and mortality risk.MethodsA systematic literature search was conducted in PubMed, EMBASE, and the Cochrane Library from inception to January 10, 2026, following PRISMA guidelines.
